steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setUiMode?.('pro'); s.reresolveFeatureFlags?.(); })()

steps.name: save-two-views
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.saveCurrentView?.('View A'); s.saveCurrentView?.('View B'); })()

steps.name: open-view-menu
steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => /^\s*View\b/.test(b.textContent.trim()) && b.getAttribute('aria-haspopup')); if (!b) { const alt = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'View'); if (!alt) throw new Error('no View trigger; buttons: ' + [...document.querySelectorAll('.toolbar button')].map(x => x.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 20).join('|')); alt.click(); return; } b.click(); })()

steps.name: probe-toggle
steps.eval: (() => { const has = document.body.textContent.includes('Day → night sweep'); if (!has) throw new Error('Day → night sweep toggle NOT in Pro View menu'); return 'present'; })()

steps.name: enable-sweep-ui
steps.eval: (() => { const el = [...document.querySelectorAll('button, input, label')].find(e => (e.textContent || '').includes('Day → night sweep')); (el.querySelector('input') || el).click(); })()

steps.name: assert-hidden-simple
steps.eval: (() => { if (document.body.textContent.includes('Day → night sweep')) throw new Error('sweep toggle visible in Simple'); return 'hidden in simple'; })()

steps.name: open-mobile-menu
steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => (b.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').toLowerCase().includes('menu')); if (!b) throw new Error('no mobile menu button'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: probe-mobile
steps.eval: (() => { const secBtn = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'View'); secBtn?.click(); return 'clicked view section: ' + !!secBtn; })()

steps.name: assert-mobile-toggle
steps.eval: (() => { const has = document.body.textContent.includes('Day → night sweep'); if (!has) throw new Error('sweep toggle NOT in mobile View section'); return 'present on mobile'; })()
